# Correction to manifesto booklets

**Published: 30th May 2022**

Due to our administrative error, Kirsten Morel has been shown as a member of party on page 21 of the St John, St Lawrence and Trinity manifesto booklets being distributed to households this week. This is not correct and Kirsten Morel is standing for election as an Independent candidate.

Vote.je sincerely apologises for this mistake. We are in the process of rectifying this and an updated leaflet containing the correct details will be circulated this week.
